hints.title: Bit Clear Capability
hints.text: The operation nums[i] = nums[i] and (nums[i] xor x) allows clearing any arbitrary set of bits from nums[i].

hints.title: Independent Bit Feasibility
hints.text: If at least one element in nums has its b-th bit set to 1, we can clear the b-th bit in all other elements so exactly one 1 remains.

hints.title: Cumulative Bitwise Union
hints.text: Every bit position that contains at least one 1 can be set in the final total. Thus the answer is the bitwise union over all nums.

hints.title: Bitwise OR Reduction Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass cumulative bitwise OR reduction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Attempting to search through possible operation values x is combinatorially unfeasible.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves that the operation is strictly equivalent to arbitrary bit clearing.
